units.rawText: At the rest area.
units.displayText: At the rest area.

spans.text: At the rest area.

units.rawText: <Size=40>Hrk!</size> (throws up)
units.displayText: <Size=40>Hrk! (throws up)

spans.text: <Size=40>Hrk!
(throws up)

units.rawText: You absolute clown! I knew there was no damn way you could hold it in!
units.displayText: You absolute clown! I knew there was no damn way you could hold it in!

spans.text: You absolute clown! I knew there was no damn way you could hold it in!

units.rawText: Centaureissi! Peter threw up. Cleanup please!
units.displayText: Centaureissi! Peter threw up. Cleanup please!

spans.text: Centaureissi! Peter threw up. Cleanup please!

units.rawText: Alright. Please sit Peter upright so his vomit does not flow back into his windpipe.
units.displayText: Alright. Please sit Peter upright so his vomit does not flow back into his windpipe.

spans.text: Alright. Please sit Peter upright so his vomit does not flow back into his windpipe.

units.rawText: Okay, so I should hold him like this?
units.displayText: Okay, so I should hold him like this?

spans.text: Okay, so I should hold him like this?

units.rawText: (Coughs) Mama... are you... there... (throws up)
units.displayText: (Coughs) Mama... are you... there... (throws up)

spans.text: (Coughs) Mama... are you... there... (throws up)

units.rawText: F**k! Peter, do you have your sack in your mouth, you stupid bastard?
units.displayText: F**k! Peter, do you have your sack in your mouth, you stupid bastard?

spans.text: F**k! Peter, do you have your sack in your mouth, you stupid bastard?

units.rawText: I will help wash your clothing and send them to the appropriate room. Please remain calm.
units.displayText: I will help wash your clothing and send them to the appropriate room. Please remain calm.

spans.text: I will help wash your clothing and send them to the appropriate room. Please remain calm.

units.rawText: ...Alright then. Otherwise, I'll make Peter do it.
units.displayText: ...Alright then. Otherwise, I'll make Peter do it.

spans.text: ...Alright then. Otherwise, I'll make Peter do it.

units.rawText: Hah, why don't you politely go and ask the enemy not to splash you in the face with blood when you're in the trenches? Or are you only a badass at home?
units.displayText: Hah, why don't you politely go and ask the enemy not to splash you in the face with blood when you're in the trenches? Or are you only a badass at home?

spans.text: Hah, why don't you politely go and ask the enemy not to splash you in the face with blood when you're in the trenches? Or are you only a badass at home?

units.rawText: Beep. Beep, beep. The sound of an incoming transmission fills the air and interrupts the soldiers' feuding.
units.displayText: Beep. Beep, beep. The sound of an incoming transmission fills the air and interrupts the soldiers' feuding.

spans.text: Beep. Beep, beep. The sound of an incoming transmission fills the air and interrupts the soldiers' feuding.

units.rawText: Huh? What does that hunk of junk coming back have to do with me...
units.displayText: Huh? What does that hunk of junk coming back have to do with me...

spans.text: Huh? What does that hunk of junk coming back have to do with me...

units.rawText: A rescue signal? For whom!?
units.displayText: A rescue signal? For whom!?

spans.text: A rescue signal? For whom!?

units.rawText: Soldier C's face turns pale as he ends the transmission and waves Soldier B over.
units.displayText: Soldier C's face turns pale as he ends the transmission and waves Soldier B over.

spans.text: Soldier C's face turns pale as he ends the transmission and waves Soldier B over.

units.rawText: The Lt.'s in trouble! Charlie, get the medics! Peter...
units.displayText: The Lt.'s in trouble! Charlie, get the medics! Peter...

spans.text: The Lt.'s in trouble! Charlie, get the medics! Peter...

units.rawText: I will take care of Peter.
units.displayText: I will take care of Peter.

spans.text: I will take care of Peter.

units.rawText: Soldier C nods to her and runs out of the hall with the other soldier.
units.displayText: Soldier C nods to her and runs out of the hall with the other soldier.

spans.text: Soldier C nods to her and runs out of the hall with the other soldier.

units.rawText: Lieutenant Albert's smile flashes through her processor module.
units.displayText: Lieutenant Albert's smile flashes through her processor module.

spans.text: Lieutenant Albert's smile flashes through her processor module.

units.rawText: She dismisses the notion of going after them immediately and sends Soldier A back to his cleaned room.
units.displayText: She dismisses the notion of going after them immediately and sends Soldier A back to his cleaned room.

spans.text: She dismisses the notion of going after them immediately and sends Soldier A back to his cleaned room.

units.rawText: One minute later, at the base entrance.
units.displayText: One minute later, at the base entrance.

spans.text: One minute later, at the base entrance.

units.rawText: The medics are still getting ready! Where's the rescue signal? We'll check it out!
units.displayText: The medics are still getting ready! Where's the rescue signal? We'll check it out!

spans.text: The medics are still getting ready! Where's the rescue signal? We'll check it out!

units.rawText: I see it! Over there!
units.displayText: I see it! Over there!

spans.text: I see it! Over there!

units.rawText: The soldiers run out of the base and gingerly unload the coffin from Clotho's back.
units.displayText: The soldiers run out of the base and gingerly unload the coffin from Clotho's back.

spans.text: The soldiers run out of the base and gingerly unload the coffin from Clotho's back.

units.rawText: The others surge forward and shove Clotho aside.
units.displayText: The others surge forward and shove Clotho aside.

spans.text: The others surge forward and shove Clotho aside.

units.rawText: What the hell? Relax and stop touching me. I'm opening it up already!
units.displayText: What the hell? Relax and stop touching me. I'm opening it up already!

spans.text: What the hell? Relax and stop touching me. I'm opening it up already!

units.rawText: What's going on, what happened? How's the Lt.?
units.displayText: What's going on, what happened? How's the Lt.?

spans.text: What's going on, what happened? How's the Lt.?

units.rawText: Albert lies still inside the coffin, his face pale.
units.displayText: Albert lies still inside the coffin, his face pale.

spans.text: Albert lies still inside the coffin, his face pale.

units.rawText: Lt.! Hey, Lt., wake up!
units.displayText: Lt.! Hey, Lt., wake up!

spans.text: Lt.! Hey, Lt., wake up!

units.rawText: ...He's not breathing.
units.displayText: ...He's not breathing.

spans.text: ...He's not breathing.

units.rawText: ...It's okay, he can still be saved, I'm sure of it.
units.displayText: ...It's okay, he can still be saved, I'm sure of it.

spans.text: ...It's okay, he can still be saved, I'm sure of it.

units.rawText: Ah, that's right! I've seen the medics bring people back before! They can save you even if your heart stops! Dammit, where the hell are the medics?!
units.displayText: Ah, that's right! I've seen the medics bring people back before! They can save you even if your heart stops! Dammit, where the hell are the medics?!

spans.text: Ah, that's right! I've seen the medics bring people back before! They can save you even if your heart stops! Dammit, where the hell are the medics?!

units.rawText: ...You're right, we need to start CPR!
units.displayText: ...You're right, we need to start CPR!

spans.text: ...You're right, we need to start CPR!

units.rawText: The soldiers seem unusually high-strung. They remove Albert from the coffin and lay him on the ground before starting CPR on him.
units.displayText: The soldiers seem unusually high-strung. They remove Albert from the coffin and lay him on the ground before starting CPR on him.

spans.text: The soldiers seem unusually high-strung. They remove Albert from the coffin and lay him on the ground before starting CPR on him.

units.rawText: It'll be okay as long as we hold out until the medics arrive!
units.displayText: It'll be okay as long as we hold out until the medics arrive!

spans.text: It'll be okay as long as we hold out until the medics arrive!

units.rawText: Albert's cold chest is covered with blood and dust. Tears well up in the corners of the eyes of the soldier performing CPR on him. He quickly wipes them away, leaving a comical smear on his face.
units.displayText: Albert's cold chest is covered with blood and dust. Tears well up in the corners of the eyes of the soldier performing CPR on him. He quickly wipes them away, leaving a comical smear on his face.

spans.text: Albert's cold chest is covered with blood and dust. Tears well up in the corners of the eyes of the soldier performing CPR on him. He quickly wipes them away, leaving a comical smear on his face.

units.rawText: The last cries of the soldier she buried a few days earlier still echo in Clotho's ears, and she finds that these living soldiers sound just like him.
units.displayText: The last cries of the soldier she buried a few days earlier still echo in Clotho's ears, and she finds that these living soldiers sound just like him.

spans.text: The last cries of the soldier she buried a few days earlier still echo in Clotho's ears, and she finds that these living soldiers sound just like him.

units.rawText: They are filled with despair, like a trapped beast thrashing around in mud and blood.
units.displayText: They are filled with despair, like a trapped beast thrashing around in mud and blood.

spans.text: They are filled with despair, like a trapped beast thrashing around in mud and blood.

units.rawText: ...Death has its roots in him. His soul is bound for the far shore.
units.displayText: ...Death has its roots in him. His soul is bound for the far shore.

spans.text: ...Death has its roots in him. His soul is bound for the far shore.

units.rawText: <size=40>You shut the hell up!</size>
units.displayText: You shut the hell up!

spans.text: You shut the hell up!

units.rawText: The soldiers seem to have found an outlet for their emotions. One of them gets up, his hands balled into fists and his eyes bloodshot.
units.displayText: The soldiers seem to have found an outlet for their emotions. One of them gets up, his hands balled into fists and his eyes bloodshot.

spans.text: The soldiers seem to have found an outlet for their emotions. One of them gets up, his hands balled into fists and his eyes bloodshot.

units.rawText: Bam!
units.displayText: Bam!

spans.text: Bam!

units.rawText: You took your own sweet time running back and killed him! And you still have the nerve to say that?!
units.displayText: You took your own sweet time running back and killed him! And you still have the nerve to say that?!

spans.text: You took your own sweet time running back and killed him! And you still have the nerve to say that?!

units.rawText: Clotho lifts her head from where she's been knocked to the ground. The skin on her face is slightly ripped.
units.displayText: Clotho lifts her head from where she's been knocked to the ground. The skin on her face is slightly ripped.

spans.text: Clotho lifts her head from where she's been knocked to the ground. The skin on her face is slightly ripped.

units.rawText: Hey, come on, cool it!
units.displayText: Hey, come on, cool it!

spans.text: Hey, come on, cool it!

units.rawText: ...It was my fault.
units.displayText: ...It was my fault.

spans.text: ...It was my fault.

units.rawText: Clotho!? Don't say that, you're just asking for... Uwah!
units.displayText: Clotho!? Don't say that, you're just asking for... Uwah!

spans.text: Clotho!? Don't say that, you're just asking for... Uwah!

units.rawText: Soldier C kicks the coffin away and stalks over to Clotho with his fists clenched.
units.displayText: Soldier C kicks the coffin away and stalks over to Clotho with his fists clenched.

spans.text: Soldier C kicks the coffin away and stalks over to Clotho with his fists clenched.

units.rawText: Well, since you've admitted it, there's nothing more to say, is there?
units.displayText: Well, since you've admitted it, there's nothing more to say, is there?

spans.text: Well, since you've admitted it, there's nothing more to say, is there?

units.rawText: Oi, you're going too far! Go regret what you did by yourselves if you want, but why do you have to beat up Dolls? Clotho was just doing her job!
units.displayText: Oi, you're going too far! Go regret what you did by yourselves if you want, but why do you have to beat up Dolls? Clotho was just doing her job!

spans.text: Oi, you're going too far! Go regret what you did by yourselves if you want, but why do you have to beat up Dolls? Clotho was just doing her job!

units.rawText: It was my fault... If I had been faster... then that life, which was still attached to this world, would not have had to journey across the river.
units.displayText: It was my fault... If I had been faster... then that life, which was still attached to this world, would not have had to journey across the river.

spans.text: It was my fault... If I had been faster... then that life, which was still attached to this world, would not have had to journey across the river.

units.rawText: ...It was my fault. I am sorry.
units.displayText: ...It was my fault. I am sorry.

spans.text: ...It was my fault. I am sorry.

units.rawText: The soldier freezes up. From emptiness, to remorse, to misery... his face contorts with various expressions.
units.displayText: The soldier freezes up. From emptiness, to remorse, to misery... his face contorts with various expressions.

spans.text: The soldier freezes up. From emptiness, to remorse, to misery... his face contorts with various expressions.

units.rawText: What's the point... of you saying all that now?
units.displayText: What's the point... of you saying all that now?

spans.text: What's the point... of you saying all that now?

units.rawText: His hand remains in the air like he's going to hit Clotho, and then it falls back down limply.
units.displayText: His hand remains in the air like he's going to hit Clotho, and then it falls back down limply.

spans.text: His hand remains in the air like he's going to hit Clotho, and then it falls back down limply.

units.rawText: Dammit... Goddammit... Why... <size=40>I won't let those f**ks who blew up the road get away!</size>
units.displayText: Dammit... Goddammit... Why... I won't let those f**ks who blew up the road get away!

spans.text: Dammit... Goddammit... Why...
I won't let those f**ks who blew up the road get away!

units.rawText: Everyone, the medical team has arrived!
units.displayText: Everyone, the medical team has arrived!

spans.text: Everyone, the medical team has arrived!

units.rawText: Centaureissi leads the medics over. She takes a look around before silently pulling Clotho behind her.
units.displayText: Centaureissi leads the medics over. She takes a look around before silently pulling Clotho behind her.

spans.text: Centaureissi leads the medics over. She takes a look around before silently pulling Clotho behind her.

units.rawText: I understand that everyone must be in great pain right now, but let us take care of the lieutenant first.
units.displayText: I understand that everyone must be in great pain right now, but let us take care of the lieutenant first.

spans.text: I understand that everyone must be in great pain right now, but let us take care of the lieutenant first.

units.rawText: The soldiers who had been so worked up just now are silent.
units.displayText: The soldiers who had been so worked up just now are silent.

spans.text: The soldiers who had been so worked up just now are silent.

units.rawText: Despite being so rough-and-tumble normally, they carefully lift Albert up and lay him on the stretcher that the medics brought over.
units.displayText: Despite being so rough-and-tumble normally, they carefully lift Albert up and lay him on the stretcher that the medics brought over.

spans.text: Despite being so rough-and-tumble normally, they carefully lift Albert up and lay him on the stretcher that the medics brought over.

units.rawText: Clotho watches as they leave, going further and further away... Until they are swallowed up by the grayish-white buildings and vanish from sight.
units.displayText: Clotho watches as they leave, going further and further away... Until they are swallowed up by the grayish-white buildings and vanish from sight.

spans.text: Clotho watches as they leave, going further and further away... Until they are swallowed up by the grayish-white buildings and vanish from sight.
